localization_function_inventory.text: #tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_supply_rules Supplies and livelihoods#!#!
#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_supply_rules 货源与生计#!#!

Wu shipping brings grain from the Southern Seas, distant timber and foreign goods into the Southern realm. Inland workshops, garrisons and academies already depend on those exchanges. Provincial powers differ, but production and livelihoods can scarcely stand apart from the common market. Closing a port or severing a trade route spreads losses far beyond it.\n\nAs the Ming court and Hangzhou dispute the succession, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must keep its government and forces functioning. Offices need paper, garrisons need recruits and arms, and academy students are preparing to enter political life. We must maintain trade with willing partners and make local workshops, schools and livelihoods capable of enduring the present disruption.

吴人的海船把南洋稻米、远方木材与各国货物运进南朝，内陆工坊、营伍与书院也早已依赖这些往来。各省虽保有不同的地方势力，生产和生计却已难以独立于共同市场。停下一处港口、截断一条商路，损失便会传到远方。\n\n明廷与南府争论帝统时，[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]仍须维持自己的军政。官署要用纸，营伍要补兵添械，书院中的监生也正从讲席走向议政。我们既要同愿意往来的诸邦维持交易，又要使本地工坊、学校与乡里的生计经得住眼前的动荡。
#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_supply_rules Supplies and livelihoods#!#!
#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_supply_rules 货源与生计#!#!
An active [concept_bankruptcy] penalty interrupts consolidation.
国家仍受[concept_bankruptcy]惩罚，巩固月份已中断。
南洋联省的海船将染料运往江南，田主和商行从这条航路上收取地租、货款与利息。沿岸的村社也被卷入了这场繁荣：农户把收成交给园主，流民向承包人借钱，下一年的劳动便早早写进了债契。\n\n[Country.GetName]需要伐木、搬运和经营港务的人，也需要留下能够养活一家人的稻田。让新雇工领到工钱、让佃户留住收成，将决定联省的腹地能否成为一个有买卖、有积蓄的地方。

Wu's armies have entered the west, but the Ming loyalists have not disappeared with their defeated commanders. Chengdu, Xiangyang and Northern Guangxi still harbour attachments to the old dynasty. Local scholars are reluctant to recognise the new court in Hangzhou. Military conquest must now be followed by provincial administration and the authority of the Assembly of Rites.\n\nThe three regions must be [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','incorporated')] before #v 1850#!. Further delay will spread discontent among the Jingchu, Southwestern, Hakka and Yue populations.
吴军已入西部，反吴复明的旧部却没有随败军一同消失。成都、襄阳与桂北仍有人怀念旧主，地方士人也不愿轻易承认杭州的新朝。军队能够攻下城池，朝廷却还要让三地接受布政司与礼议院的秩序。\n\n朝廷须在#v 1850年以前#!将三地变为[concept_incorporated_state]。拖延下去，西府的怨愤还会向荆楚、西南、客家与粤地蔓延。
